@graph.name: Website Audits for Real Estate Developers Selling to International Buyers
@graph.description: Buyers of property abroad invest large sums and read every term carefully. We check property descriptions, purchase terms, prices, floor areas, and units of measurement. Buyers see careless text as a sign of an unreliable company.

@graph.name: Website Audits for Real Estate Developers Selling to International Buyers

mainEntity.name: What matters most to check on a developer's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices, floor areas, purchase terms, units of measurement, and sales office contacts. An error in any of these makes buyers doubt everything else.

mainEntity.name: Do you need access to the website's content management system?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We review the website the way your customers see it. All we need to start is the website address and a business email.
